items.title: [Bug] Schema validation inconsistencies across legacy company profiles
items.description:
**Describe the bug**
Running the offline validator (`validate-companies.js`) across all 886 markdown files in `src/companies/` revealed several recurring schema inconsistencies on legacy profiles:
1. **Slug Mismatches**: 43 files had frontmatter `slug` values that did not match their file slug (e.g. `akamai.md` had `slug: akamai-technologies-inc`).
2. **Missing `company_size`**: 33 profiles lacked the required `company_size` enum value (`tiny`, `small`, `medium`, `large`, `enterprise`).
3. **Section Heading Inconsistencies**: Multiple files had non-standard headings (double spaces like `##  Company blurb` or missing mandatory sections like `## Remote status` / `## How to apply`).
4. **URL Syntax Typo**: `akamai.md` had a trailing `]\` character in its `careers_url`.

**Expected behavior**
All company profiles in `src/companies/*.md` should adhere to the required schema fields and headings defined in `validate-companies.js` without errors.

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
- OS: Windows / Linux
- Tool: Node.js validation runner

**Additional context**
A comprehensive pull request resolving all 96 affected files has already been submitted and passed CI checks: #2302.

items.title: 57 company profiles missing company_size or required sections
items.description:
These 57 company profiles fail `.github/scripts/validate-companies.js` because they're missing something only a person can fill in. Until they're fixed, **anyone who opens a PR touching one of these files gets a failing validation check** for problems they didn't cause.

(Invalid tech tags and slug/filename mismatches are being fixed separately in #2294 and #2293.)

## How to help

Pick one or a few, check the company's own website, and open a PR. Please keep each PR to a handful of profiles so they're easy to review.

- **`company_size`**: add one of `tiny` (1–10 employees), `small` (11–50), `medium` (51–200), `large` (201–1000) or `enterprise` (1000+). The company's About page or LinkedIn usually says.
- **Missing sections**: add the heading listed (`## Company blurb`, `## Remote status` or `## How to apply`) with a short, factual paragraph. For `Remote status`, describe the company's actual remote policy as the company states it, not a guess.
- If the company has **closed or been acquired**, say so in a comment here instead of filling it in, and we'll remove the profile (see #2271 for an example).

See [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/remoteintech/remote-jobs/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full format. You can check your work locally with `node .github/scripts/validate-companies.js src/companies/<file>.md`.

Tick a box once its PR is merged.

items.title: 9 company profiles whose domains no longer exist
items.description:
While checking careers links across `src/companies/` (2026-10-11), I found profiles whose company website and careers page are both unreachable. For these 9, the domain no longer resolves at all (NXDOMAIN, checked twice), so the company looks closed or renamed:

| Profile | Website |
|---|---|
| Cuvette | https://cuvette.tech |
| GitPrime | https://gitprime.com/ (acquired by Pluralsight in 2019) |
| Grou.ps | https://build.gr.ps |
| Impira | https://www.impira.com/ |
| Mobile Jazz | https://mobilejazz.com |
| Park Assist | https://tech.parkassist.com |
| Pathable | https://pathable.com/ |
| Socket Supply Co | https://socketsupply.co |
| Telestax Inc. | https://telestax.com/ |

Related:
- **Interactive Intelligence**: `inin.com` now redirects to Genesys, which acquired it.
- **Bugfender**: its `careers_url` is `https://mobilejazz.com/jobs`, on the dead Mobile Jazz domain above.

CONTRIBUTING says profiles are normally removed when a company no longer meets the criteria, so I didn't want to delete these without asking. Happy to open a PR removing them (and fixing Bugfender's link) if you agree.

(Separately, #2270 updates 9 careers links that moved.)
